description: Source code for Android device and browser management within Playwright, including device enumeration, webview handling, driver installation, and browser launching.

classes.name: Android
classes.description: Manages multiple Android devices, providing device enumeration and management.

classes.name: AndroidDevice
classes.description: Represents an individual Android device, providing methods for shell commands, webview management, driver installation, and browser launching.

classes.name: AndroidBrowser
classes.description: Represents a browser session on an Android device, managing WebSocket communication and WebView connections.

classes.name: ClankBrowserProcess
classes.description: Implements BrowserProcess interface for controlling the Android browser process.

methods.name: Android.devices
methods.description: Retrieves list of connected Android devices.

methods.name: AndroidDevice.create
methods.description: Creates and initializes an AndroidDevice instance.

methods.name: AndroidDevice._init
methods.description: Initializes the device, including webview refresh polling.

methods.name: AndroidDevice.shell
methods.description: Executes a shell command on the device.

methods.name: AndroidDevice.open
methods.description: Opens a socket connection to the device.

methods.name: AndroidDevice.screenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of the device.

methods.name: AndroidDevice._driver
methods.description: Gets or installs the driver transport.

methods.name: AndroidDevice._installDriver
methods.description: Installs and starts the Android driver.

methods.name: AndroidDevice._waitForLocalAbstract
methods.description: Waits for a local abstract socket connection.

methods.name: AndroidDevice.send
methods.description: Sends a message to the device via the driver.

methods.name: AndroidDevice.close
methods.description: Closes the device connection and cleans up.

methods.name: AndroidDevice.launchBrowser
methods.description: Launches a browser on the Android device.

methods.name: AndroidDevice._defaultArgs
methods.description: Generates default command-line arguments for launching Chrome.

methods.name: AndroidDevice._innerDefaultArgs
methods.description: Generates inner default arguments, including proxy settings.

methods.name: AndroidDevice.connectToWebView
methods.description: Connects to a WebView for debugging.

methods.name: AndroidDevice._connectToBrowser
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the browser within the WebView.

methods.name: AndroidDevice._open
methods.description: Opens a device command connection.

methods.name: AndroidDevice.webViews
methods.description: Returns list of current WebViews.

methods.name: AndroidDevice.installApk
methods.description: Installs an APK on the device.

methods.name: AndroidDevice.push
methods.description: Pushes files to the device.

methods.name: AndroidDevice._refreshWebViews
methods.description: Refreshes the list of WebViews.

methods.name: AndroidDevice._extractPkg
methods.description: Extracts package name from process list.

methods.name: AndroidBrowser._init
methods.description: Initializes the AndroidBrowser, establishing WebSocket connection.

methods.name: AndroidBrowser.send
methods.description: Sends a message over WebSocket.

methods.name: AndroidBrowser.close
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: ClankBrowserProcess.kill
methods.description: Kills the browser process (no-op).

methods.name: ClankBrowserProcess.close
methods.description: Closes the browser process.
